title: The Aral Sea (MODIS 2019-10-11).jpg
author: NASA GSFC MODIS Rapid Response
credit: This image or video was catalogued by Goddard Space Flight Center of the United States National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) under Photo ID: 2019-10-11.
description: Once one of the four largest lakes on Earth, the Aral Sea has shrunk dramatically in recent years, with only about 10 percent of the original waters remaining. For thousands of years the Aral Sea was an expansive land-locked lake spanning more than 68,000 square kilometers (26,255 sq. mi), a size just a little smaller than the Republic of Ireland. It measured almost 435 km (270 mi) at its longest
